# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Updated the shrimp scenario probe suite to close the remaining review amendments in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs`: the successful-breeding doc comment now matches the 60-day run, the breeding probe now counts complete berried->hatch cycles from emitted events instead of loose 10-day berried windows, and the thermal-suppression fixture now reuses the stable breeding baseline so the cool control stays chemically healthy. The thermal probe also seeds active berried females, applies a deterministic 25->31 C heat-shock setup, uses temperature-matched water changes plus chemistry envelopes to keep temperature as the main differing variable, and explicitly asserts warm-arm egg dropping alongside cool-control health.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the pending shrimp-scenario amendments and the current breeding/thermal probe behavior to identify the weakest assertions and the confounded thermal fixture.
2. [Completed] Patch the successful-breeding probe so its doc comment matches the implemented duration and its cycle assertion requires event-backed berried/hatch evidence rather than simple window occupancy.
3. [Completed] Rebuild the thermal-suppression scenario on top of the stable breeding fixture, add temperature-matched maintenance guardrails, seed an in-flight clutch for the heat-shock arm, and assert both warm-arm egg dropping and cool-arm baseline health.
4. [Completed] Format the updated probe file and rerun the shrimp scenario suite plus targeted breeding/thermal tests to verify the amended scenarios pass with the intended directional outcomes.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully after the probe edits.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes -- --nocapture` passed; all 6 tests succeeded and the summary runner reported all 5 probes passing with successful breeding `cycles=10, berried_days=18, hatch_days=10` and thermal suppression `cool_egg_drops=0, warm_egg_drops=1`.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes probe_successful_breeding -- --nocapture` passed; the healthy breeding run finished `initial=10, final=260` with 10 complete event-backed cycles across 60 days.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes probe_thermal_suppression -- --nocapture` passed; the cool control stayed healthy (`cond=0.926`, `molt_stress=0.009`, `NO2=0.1057`) while the warm arm showed suppressed reproduction and explicit egg dropping (`warm_egg_drops=1`, `warm_juv=0`, `warm_readiness=0.017`).

## Outstanding Risks

- The thermal probe now intentionally depends on seeded berried females plus a first-day 25->31 C heat shock to exercise the egg-dropping path; if future egg-drop or thermal dynamics are retuned substantially, that fixture may need adjustment.
- The worktree still contains unrelated pre-existing changes in `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` and `.ralph-burning/`, which were left untouched.
